title: OpenAI says it's doubling Pro usage limits and bringing Work features to Chat
hook_text: OpenAI just doubled Pro usage limits.
script:
OpenAI just doubled ChatGPT Pro usage limits for all subscribers.
Users now get twice the capacity for heavy tasks and advanced models.
This sudden change follows backlash over a planned fifty percent cut.
Work features are also moving directly into consumer chat interfaces.
Teams can collaborate faster without switching separate software tools.
Will this upgrade change how you run your daily projects?
